findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies the account lockout trigger but omits the lockout duration, unlock/recovery condition, and any error message or notification returned to the Member.

findings.evidence: notify him
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has an ambiguous antecedent; it is unclear whether the Notification Service should notify the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved placeholder ('TBD') for the password-reset token expiration duration.

findings.evidence: user-friendly, easy to navigate, loads rapidly, standard connections
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unmeasurable terms without defining objective usability criteria, load-time thresholds, or network bandwidth baselines.

findings.evidence: TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved placeholder ('TBD') for the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals permitted.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Specifies only the successful self-checkout path and omits error handling when item eligibility validation fails or a barcode cannot be read.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a maximum cap on active hold requests without specifying the concrete numeric limit.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-009, which restricts an active Member in good standing to at most 5 physical items checked out simultaneously.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days from the checkout timestamp
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-010, which sets the standard loan duration for circulating print books to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-001, which requires a Librarian to verify a government-issued photo ID and record full name, email address, and phone number before creating a Member account.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-011, which requires holding reserved items for exactly 72 hours and automatically cancelling uncollected holds to notify the next Member in queue.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Uses chained 'and/or' coordination, leaving it ambiguous which exact combination of the three actions must occur when an item is 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without specifying which actor or role (e.g., Librarian or Administrator) is responsible for reviewing, approving, and recording fine waiver requests.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: Uses the subjective weak phrase 'if appropriate' without defining the criteria for dispatching SMS due-date alerts or how far before the due date they should be sent.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved placeholder ('TBD') for the archival retention period of payment receipts.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-019, which sets the overdue fine at $0.50 USD per overdue day per item capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-020, which blocks any Member with an unpaid fine balance exceeding $5.00 USD from borrowing or renewing items.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count ... Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Uses the inconsistent term 'Patron' instead of the established term 'Member' used throughout the specification, including SD-009 for the same 5-item borrowing limit.

findings.evidence: quickly, many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('quickly', 'many users') without defining concrete search latency thresholds or concurrent user load requirements.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: Uses the non-committal weak phrase 'where possible' without specifying the exact conditions under which term highlighting is required or exempt.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy, acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, untestable terms ('sufficient', 'acceptable') instead of measurable accuracy metrics and maximum response-time bounds.

findings.evidence: efficiently, large batch MARC21 files, noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses vague qualifiers without defining processing throughput, batch file size limits, or measurable performance degradation thresholds.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: States only that the Catalog Service shall detect active loans or holds on deletion attempt, without specifying the required action or consequence (e.g., blocking deletion and returning an error).

findings.evidence: TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved placeholder ('TBD') for the execution schedule of encrypted full database backups.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions, in a timely manner, appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses vague, unquantified terms instead of enumerating which administrative actions must be audited, the maximum logging latency, and the exact retention duration.

findings.evidence: shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Specifies only logging an event when the primary database node becomes unreachable, omitting the actual failover and recovery actions (such as promoting a replica or alerting Administrators).

findings.evidence: adequate transport security, clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unmeasurable terms ('adequate', 'clear') without specifying concrete transport security standards (e.g., TLS version) or testable error message criteria.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-002, which requires Member passwords of at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-004, which terminates authenticated web portal sessions after 15 minutes of user inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-003, which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing (cost factor 12) for all passwords and prohibits storing or exposing plaintext passwords.
